nodes.label: We raise it — the eight details needed

config.question: I understand, Sir or Ma'am. If you're unable to place the request through SMS or I-V-R, I can help you by raising the paper roll request on your behalf. nodes.label: Charging steps (adapter, 4 hours, 80%)

config.prompt: Sir for the next step, please ensure that the charging adapter is properly connected to the power socket and the terminal. Kindly check whether the charging indicator is displayed on the terminal. If an alternate compatible adapter is available, you may also try using it to check whether the issue is related to the charging adapter. Please keep the terminal connected to the charger for at least 4 hours. After 4 hours, kindly check the battery percentage displayed on the terminal. If the battery percentage is 80% or above and the terminal is working normally, the issue should be resolved. However, if the battery percentage remains below 80% or the charging issue persists, please contact us again so that we can raise a service docket and arrange a visit from our Field Service Engineer (FSE) to inspect and resolve the issue.
